name: aria.dev/skills/usage-reporting
description: Generates usage evaluation reports in Markdown or JSON from metrics, conformance, and anomaly results, plus plain-language findings summaries.
triggers: Generate a usage report for last month
Give me a Markdown report of provider spend and anomalies
Summarize the findings from this usage evaluation
Export the usage evaluation as JSON
usage: Call generate_usage_report with metrics (and optional conformance, anomalies, format markdown|json, title); summarize_findings for a headline with severity counts.
